fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run RunVerdict) assert a downgrade of a major to minor is journaled with both severities, and a downgrade to major of a major, to blocker, or with no severity exits as a usage error; go test -trimpath ./internal/run covers the journal entry; describe-golden is regenerated (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/describe-golden).
fields.statement: rhiza run verdict accepts a third verdict, downgraded, with a severity lower than the finding's (blocker to major, minor or nit; major to minor or nit), journaled with the finding's original severity; a downgrade to the same or a higher severity, or without a severity, is refused.

fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/run (go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'Checks|Critic') run a checks step where a check's only major is downgraded to minor and assert the check passes with no fixer session started, while a confirmed major still starts the fixer; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'RunStatus|ReviewSummary' asserts both severities are shown.
fields.statement: A downgraded finding counts at its lower severity: a check whose surviving findings are all minor or nit after the critic passes its cycle without a fixer, and rhiza run status and the review summary show each downgraded finding with its original and lower severity.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide -run 'Review|Plan' asserts review.md and plan-review.md contain the same severity block byte for byte, that both critic sections name confirmed, downgraded and dropped, and that the block names no Go, make or Rhiza-repo command.
fields.statement: The review and plan-review guide topics hold one shared severity block, byte for byte: blocker (behaviour broken, a build or test fails, or a leaf is missing), major (an acceptance point unmet or a real defect), minor (style, naming, docs or a non-blocking follow-up) and nit, with a mapping per check; and the critic sections say confirm, downgrade or drop, never add or raise.
